page_title: NAN 1-1 PSG | Nantes v PSG 22/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+2' Crossbar! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
86' Antoine Kombouare has decided to make a change. Fabien Centonze (Nantes) replaces Matthis Abline.
86' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Pedro Chirivella leaves the pitch to be replaced by Tino Kadewere (Nantes).
83' 1 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Douglas Augusto (Nantes) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
79' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jeremie Pignard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
79' Desire Doue (PSG) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
79' Bradley Barcola (PSG) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jeremie Pignard ignores the protests.
75' Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
74' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bradley Barcola (PSG).
73' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
73' Antoine Kombouare decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Pallois will be replaced by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes).

72' Bradley Barcola (PSG) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Nantes, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
71' Here comes a substitution. Senny Mayulu (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
68' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
66' Vitinha (PSG) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Patrik Carlgren pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
63' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kang-In Lee trots off the pitch and is replaced by Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Desire Doue (PSG) comes onto the pitch for Ousmane Dembele.
62' Here is a change. Warren Zaire-Emery is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Bradley Barcola (PSG).
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Willian Pacho (PSG) coming on for Nuno Mendes.
62' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

61' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Corner kick. Nantes will have an opportunity.
60' The resulting corner from Moses Simon (Nantes) comes to nothing.
57' Moses Simon (Nantes) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
57' Moses Simon (Nantes) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
56' Moses Simon (Nantes) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates.
55' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) commits a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Nantes, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
55' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
49' Kang-In Lee (PSG) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
44' Nuno Mendes (PSG) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

43' Joao Neves (PSG) drives a shot towards the right side of the goal from inside the box, but Patrik Carlgren leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
42' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) was too forceful with his tackle and Jeremie Pignard interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Nantes will take a free kick.
41' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
38' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
37' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) makes a strong challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul. Nantes earn a free kick.

33' 0 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Vitinha (PSG) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
30' Patrik Carlgren blocks Ousmane Dembele (PSG)'s effort from the edge of the box.
28' Joao Neves (PSG) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
24' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. PSG have a free kick.
23' Kang-In Lee (PSG) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
20' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) brings an opponent down and Jeremie Pignard interrupts the game. There is a free kick near the sideline to Nantes.
18' Moses Simon (Nantes) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
17' Matthis Abline (Nantes) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
16' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
16' The ball is cleared after Moses Simon (Nantes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
14' Moses Simon (Nantes) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
13' Moses Simon (Nantes) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
11' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
10' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
10' Nuno Mendes (PSG) will deliver the corner kick.
9' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. PSG force a corner. They send men into the box.
5' Nuno Mendes (PSG) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
5' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. PSG get a corner.
4' Moses Simon (Nantes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
